📚 Hard vocab word #102: INSIDIOUS

insidious (adjective): harmful in a gradual, hidden way.

✅ In a sentence: Some insidious diseases cause damage long before symptoms appear.
✅ Similar: stealthy, subtle, treacherous
✅ Remember it: Slow, sneaky damage.
